Knowing how to deal with will help you to score better in IELTS reading. Many students find it difficult to deal with IELTS reading. Focusing in the keywords and synonyms will help you to deal with the problems related to IELTS Reading. The reading section becomes difficult with reading three long passages in 60 minutes and answering 40 questions correctly. Thus it becomes a challenging task and will require immense concentration. Casper Academy of Excellence is the best IELTS training institute in Kochi to deliver best coaching for all four modules.

It is crucial that you must develop the keyword technique to ace your IELTS reading with a good band score. To attain this, attending practice tests are important.

Simple Steps to Follow

While practicing IELTS Reading, following these simple steps will be helpful to you:

  • Read the question properly
  • Underline the keywords
  • Brainstorm and take a short note of keyword synonyms (so that you will not have time to note down the synonyms for each keywords)
  • Locate the keywords or keyword synonyms given in the passage
  • You must skim and scan the passage (you might have missed any keywords or their synonyms)
  • Write down the answer
  • If you are being able to do this, you can save time. This exactly is the key to success in IELTS reading.

Quick Tips for IELTS Reading

You need to know certain tips to get through the IELTS Reading. Casper Academy of Excellence, the best IELTS coaching centre in Ernakulam is giving few quick tips for IELTS Reading:

  • You will not find any identical words easily in the question and the passage. So you must not waste time finding the same words. Instead of that you must look for synonyms.
  • As you do underlining keywords in the question, you can think of synonyms for those keywords.
  • Undoubtedly, having a good vocabulary is crucial for getting a good score in IELTS reading like other modules. Similarly, you must know the synonyms of the words you learn. Thus whenever you are learning new words, you must pay attention to their synonyms too.
